en: Colorized historic postcard view of a central market square lined with multi‑story townhouses and shops. On the left stands a large Baroque church with twin onion‑domed towers and a white façade, opening onto the square. In the middle and right foreground are rows of commercial buildings with display windows and signs, with pedestrians walking along the street and a horse‑drawn vehicle. In the distance a brick tower rises above the roofs. The sky is rendered in pastel blue with light clouds. The captions "Komotau." and "Markt." are printed in red at the top.
